security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown formatting, local installation guidance, or documented use of an authenticated Paperclip API. Confirmed findings cover privileged API operations, API-key use, and two destructive reset commands that recursively delete the default embedded database. No prompt-injection text or credential-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Reset instructions recursively delete a directory under the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit path check and interactive confirmation before deletion. Prefer a dedicated reset command with safeguards.

remediation.issue: The troubleshooting command kills every process listening on port 3100.
remediation.suggestion: Identify the Paperclip-managed process before stopping it, and require confirmation before sending a signal.

remediation.issue: Hire requests can grant adapters and desired skills with expanded access.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce server-side allowlists and approval requirements for capability increases, including browser, filesystem, network, and secret access.

remediation.issue: API credentials are passed to the configured Paperclip endpoint in command examples.
remediation.suggestion: Document trusted endpoint configuration, use least-privilege scoped keys, and avoid printing request headers in logs.

content.value_statement: Creating a new agent requires consistent configuration, a clear role charter, and the correct approval process. This skill guides Paperclip users through discovery, drafting, review, submission, and approval follow-up.
actual_capabilities: Checks the current Paperclip identity and company context through the configured API.
Retrieves adapter options, allowed icons, and existing agent configurations.
Selects a role template or builds a role instruction bundle from the baseline guide.
Drafts an agent hire configuration with reporting lines, capabilities, and runtime settings.
Submits a hire request and explains the pending approval state.
Retrieves approval details and linked issues after a board decision.
limitations: Requires a running Paperclip instance and valid API environment variables.
Requires board access or the Paperclip permission to create agents.
Does not approve requests or bypass Paperclip governance controls.
Does not validate whether an adapter or installed skill is safe for every environment.

use_cases.title: Add an engineering agent
use_cases.description: Create a coding agent that follows existing team conventions and reports to the correct manager.

use_cases.title: Standardize a new role
use_cases.description: Adapt a supplied role template into a governed configuration for a new business function.

use_cases.title: Prepare an approval-ready hire
use_cases.description: Review permissions, runtime settings, and issue links before sending a request to the board.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic role
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me draft a Paperclip hire request for a QA agent. Use the existing QA template and ask for missing reporting-line details.

prompt_templates.title: Compare current configurations
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my Paperclip company agent configurations. Summarize naming, icon, adapter, and reporting-line conventions before proposing a new designer agent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a governed specialist
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a SecurityEngineer hire request. Explain every requested capability, keep heartbeats disabled, and prepare it for board approval.

prompt_templates.title: Handle an approved request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review PAPERCLIP_APPROVAL_ID, list linked issues, and propose the correct close or comment action for each issue.

output_examples.input: Create a QA agent for mobile checkout testing.
output: Draft includes a QA charter, reporting line, adapter settings, and disabled heartbeats.
Hire request is ready for approval review.

output_examples.input: Prepare a security specialist for a private advisory workflow.
output: The draft requests confirmation of a confidential workflow before assigning sensitive disclosures.
The capability justification identifies required access and leaves unneeded permissions out.

best_practices: Confirm the current identity, company, and permissions before drafting a hire.
Use the closest role template and remove instructions that do not fit the new role.
Justify every capability that expands external access, filesystem scope, or secret handling.
anti_patterns: Do not submit a hire with an unclear reporting line or role charter.
Do not enable recurring heartbeats unless scheduled work is necessary and approved.
Do not add browser, external-system, or secret access without a documented business need.

faq.question: What access is required?
faq.answer: You need board access or the Paperclip permission can_create_agents=true for the target company.

faq.question: Does the skill install Paperclip?
faq.answer: No. Paperclip must already be installed and running before using this skill.

faq.question: Can I create a role without a template?
faq.answer: Yes. The baseline role guide supports a new AGENTS.md when no supplied template fits.

faq.question: Does submitting a request activate the agent?
faq.answer: Not always. A response with an approval enters pending_approval until the board decides.

faq.question: Can the skill enable heartbeats?
faq.answer: It keeps heartbeats disabled by default and enables them only for a justified scheduled role.

faq.question: Does the skill assess third-party skills?
faq.answer: No. Review any desiredSkills and adapter capabilities separately before granting them to a new agent.
